I'm a Research Associate at the [ALERRT Center](https://alerrt.org) at Texas State University, where I turn data into life-saving strategies for first responders. My work spans the full research lifecycle, from study design and data collection to peer-reviewed publication, across topics including active threat response, officer decision-making, and the science of law enforcement training.
